assertion.statement: Each actual formal-filtration quotient in the Heegner local correction is an induced regular residue-field module with vanishing positive cohomology; in particular every additive 1-cocycle is a coboundary.
assertion.objects: pi^n O_Fprime/pi^(n+1) O_Fprime for the actual finite unramified local extension, identified with additive kprime.
assertion.hypotheses: Actual formal parameter is defined over F; pi is a base uniformizer; the formal-filtration identification is separately supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Every quotient used in successive correction and every finite unramified extension Fprime/F.
assertion.parameter_range: All prime characteristics and all extension degrees r>=1.
assertion.uniformity: No restriction that r be prime to the characteristic.
assertion.constants: No quantitative bound or division by r.
assertion.normalizations: The quotient identification is Galois equivariant because pi and the parameter are defined over F.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Does not supply the formal-filtration theorem, Neron model, Lang step, or convergence of infinite corrections.
assertion.limit_order: Compute trace and Frobenius kernels for the finite field extension before applying to each formal quotient.

use.reason: Supplies the exact residue-module H1 vanishing needed for successive formal cocycle correction by a direct finite-field calculation.

supplier.statement: For every finite extension kprime/k of finite fields, additive kprime is the regular k[Gal(kprime/k)] module and all its positive group cohomology vanishes.
